name: rope-straight-arm-pull-down
instructions:
1. Attach a rope to a cable stack and assume a standing position.
2. Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing) and lean forward slightly by hinging at the hips.
3. Keep the elbow slightly flexed and initiate the movement by depressing the shoulder blades and extending the shoulders.
4. Pull the rope toward your thigh until the lats are fully contracted and then slowly lower under control.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
